name: Acknowledgement Reason 6 Code
definition: Specifies additional information about the processed instruction.

ADEA.name: Account Servicer Deadline Missed
ADEA.definition: Received after the account servicer's deadline. Processed on best effort basis.

SMPG.name: Market Practice Rule Discrepency
SMPG.definition: Instruction is accepted but does not comply with the market practice rule published for the concerned market or process.

NSTP.name: Not Straight Through Processing
NSTP.definition: Instruction was not straight through processing and had to be processed manually.

LATE.name: Market Deadline Missed
LATE.definition: Instruction was received after market deadline.
